contexts.note: Preserve the existing brand artwork unchanged. The general activity pulse is not a logo redesign approval.
Waiting for a listener is pending, not activity or success.
Interrupted response needs attention; do not animate an activity pulse.
Keep the explicit pending label; failure remains failure and passed remains evidence-backed check.
Compare means side-by-side changes, not light/dark or contrast.
Semantic relation to the viewport select; the actual custom-select trigger is a sibling/wrapper, not necessarily a DOM descendant of the select.
Use component/text/image/group/frame only when source kind actually supports that distinction.
An instance is not a viewport/window; use component only for a known authored component.
Label-only until a coherent effect property diagram is designed; a window is not a shadow.

contexts.when: Layer blur / Background blur effect controls
contexts.note: Deliberately null artwork; retain the accurate Blur text.
Visible Layers -> Hide/close artwork; hidden Layers -> Show/open artwork. Keep the action label and expanded/pressed state synchronized.
Visible Inspector -> Hide/close artwork; hidden Inspector -> Show/open artwork. Never use compare columns for this action.
Here labels must say Hide/Show navigation rather than Layers; the geometry may be shared.
General selection pointer only. This role does not approve edits to custom Inspector property glyphs.
Live interaction mode keeps the approved play metaphor. Generic click pointer is not a blanket substitution.
Choose an authored state, not trigger a click or start playback.
Keep the textual platform shortcut separately; do not duplicate the command symbol.
An internal focused selection is not an external destination.
Archive is not the same action as delete/remove.
Text-only until a purposeful texture/noise property symbol is approved. Sparkles does not mean noise.
Text-only; a general layout icon is not texture.
The custom 16px property diagrams remain separate. Do not convert padding, margin, radius, dimension, opacity, font-family or font-size symbols to generic Lucide assets.
